gelb.refreshOnSave.description: Refresh the preview when the .gelb file is saved

gelb.stencilAnimationDurationMs.description: Total duration (ms) of the Space-triggered stencil animation in the Interactive Preview — split into four equal phases: blue (reads) fade-in / fade-out, then red (writes) fade-in / fade-out.

gelb.gelbcCommand.markdownDescription: Command that runs `gelbc` for the Problems-panel diagnostics; it may carry arguments (`uv run gelbc`), and quotes group a path with spaces. Empty (the default): found automatically, from the `.venv` (or through `uv run`) of the GeLB source checkout the file or workspace is in, a GeLB installation such as the macOS installer's `~/gelb`, or the `PATH`.

gelb.lintOnOpen.description: Run gelbc diagnostics when a .gelb file is opened.

gelb.lintOnSave.description: Run gelbc diagnostics when a .gelb file is saved.

gelb.gelbViewCommand.markdownDescription: Command that runs `gelb-view` for the previews, Lint Geometry and the Run view's viewer; arguments and quotes as for `gelb.gelbcCommand`. Empty (the default): found automatically, like `gelbc`.

gelb.gelbRunCommand.markdownDescription: Name or path of the `gelb-run` the Run view uses: one executable, no arguments (a path with spaces needs no quotes); a relative path such as `./scripts/gelb-run` is taken from the workspace folder; a bare name is looked up by VS Code's task shell. Empty (the default): found automatically, as the `scripts/gelb-run` of the GeLB source checkout the file or workspace is in, the `gelb-run` of a GeLB installation such as the macOS installer's `~/gelb`, or `gelb-run` on the `PATH`.

gelb.runOutputFolder.markdownDescription: Folder the Run view runs `gelb-run` in, which is where the `<name>.nc` output lands. Empty: next to the source file. A relative path is taken from the workspace folder; `~` and `${workspaceFolder}` are expanded; the folder is created if missing. The Run view's *Output folder* row overrides this per file.

gelb.runDefaultTimeSteps.description: Time steps (gelb-run -n) the Run view starts with for a file it has not run before.

gelb.runDefaultWriteEvery.description: Output interval (gelb-run -w) the Run view starts with for a file it has not run before.
